item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 13/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now over Beibu Wan to the coast of western Guangdong will extend eastwards gradually today and tomorrow. The associated area of low pressure will affect the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow, and bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary. With the trough of low pressure departing, it will be brighter over Guangdong early next week. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the coast of southern China midweek next week.

Weather: Cloudy with showers and isolated squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times and will ease off at night.
